logic.rejected_orders: Do not backfill rejected historical entries. A rejected exit keeps the holding and is reconsidered on the next completed 4h signal bar; terminal liquidation is separately recorded.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT unlevered long-only spot account; max affordable LOT_SIZE entry, whole valid-position exit, no cross-asset transfer, add-on, or cash yield.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete UTC daily quote-volume ADV)
parameters.exchange_filters: Frozen Binance PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL and PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE snapshot; adverse tick rounding, lot floor, prior closed 5m VWAP proxy.

sources.reported_finding: The paper reports significant negative first-order autocorrelation on 1h, 2h and 4h returns and stronger percentage reversals after larger moves. It uses historical BTC data; this batch separately tests Binance BTC/ETH under explicit current cost assumptions.

failure_gates.interpretation: Any pass applies only to repeatedly used historical screening data and is not independent or live-profit evidence.
